meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用提问弄清你想记什么,再提出一套分类(观察类型与概念标签);经你同意后把它做成 claude-mem 的自定义模式,还可以配置 Telegram 提醒,最后重启并确认模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你说要定制 claude-mem 记什么、新建或改动模式、为某些记忆加 Telegram 通知时,它会介入;即使不加 mode 这个词也接。

say.text: 给我建一个“办案”模式,记新规则、坑和观点冲突。
say.note: 会先访谈你,再提议分类并等你确认。

say.text: 再加两个观察类型:“实验结论”和“成本发现”。
say.note: 会把它们并入方案再征求确认。

say.text: 这个模式别记敏感信息,也不要发 Telegram。
say.note: 会遵守隐私边界且保留现有 Telegram 设置。

howto.what_en: Claude interviews the user, proposes note types and tags, installs the approved taxonomy as a custom claude-mem mode, optionally configures Telegram alerts, restarts the worker, and verifies the mode in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to change what claude-mem remembers, create or edit a mode, or get Telegram alerts for certain memories, even without the word "mode."

say_en.text: Create a case-log mode for new rules, pitfalls, and conflicting views.
say_en.note: It interviews first, then proposes taxonomy for approval.

say_en.text: Add two observation types: experiment outcome and cost finding.
say_en.note: It merges them into the proposal and confirms.

say_en.text: Keep sensitive info out of this mode and send no Telegram alerts.
say_en.note: It honors privacy boundaries and keeps current Telegram settings.
